title: cursor-agent rounds, the auth probe and the adapter's model check keep cursor's login in memory (AGENT_CLI_CREDENTIAL_STORE=memory), so cursor never stalls on the keychain the round denies, and fm doctor checks the installed cursor still supports it
acceptance: Why. cursor-agent rounds cannot run today, although the crew Cursor API key works. cursor-agent 2026.10.01-e373342 always tries to save its credentials to the macOS keychain, and the round sandbox and the auth-probe profile deny keychain access (`SECRET_SERVICES`, design §13.1/§13.3). So with the crew key it retries for about 30-40 s and fails: recorded by firstmate on 2026-10-05 on macOS Darwin 24.6.0 under `sandbox-exec -p "$(python3 bin/lib/fm_sandbox_policy.py auth-probe-profile)"`, the probe's `cursor-agent --list-models` did not answer within the probe's 20 s (`status: timeout` twice), and a real print-mode round (`-p --trust --sandbox disabled -f --mode ask`) took 43 s and failed with `Cursor couldn't save your credentials` / `The keychain item is stuck` (`security exit code 154`). The captain chose plan B on 2026-10-05: keep the keychain deny exactly as it is and stop cursor from wanting the keychain.

Mechanism. cursor-agent's bundle (`index.js`, module `./src/utils/credential-store.ts`) reads `AGENT_CLI_CREDENTIAL_STORE` with values `file`, `memory` or `default`; on darwin `default` is the keychain store; `memory` is an in-process store that never calls `security(1)` and persists nothing. It is not in `--help`. Recorded by firstmate on 2026-10-05, same host and profile, `env -i HOME=<empty temp dir> TMPDIR=<same> PATH USER AGENT_CLI_CREDENTIAL_STORE=memory`: the crew key -> exit 0 in about 3 s, output exactly the lines in the fixture below (no keychain warning); no `CURSOR_API_KEY` -> exit 1, `Error: Authentication required. Run 'agent login', pass --api-key/--auth-token, or set CURSOR_API_KEY/CURSOR_AUTH_TOKEN.`; `CURSOR_API_KEY=key_bogus000000` -> exit 1, `\x1b[33m⚠ Warning: The provided API key is invalid.\x1b[0m` then `The API key was loaded from the CURSOR_API_KEY environment variable.` then `Please check you have the right key, create a new one, or authenticate without it.`; a print-mode round with the crew key and `memory` printed its answer and exited 0 in 12 s. `file` also works but writes credentials to disk; it is not used.

Change 1, the adapter. bin/adapters/cursor-agent.sh exports `AGENT_CLI_CREDENTIAL_STORE=memory` once, immediately after `fm_adapter_context "$0"` (:69) and before the `command -v cursor-agent` check (:71), so it covers both cursor-agent calls: the pre-round model check `fm_adapter_model_listcheck cursor-agent … cursor-agent --list-models` (:95-101), which runs outside the OS sandbox, and the round itself (`"${FM_LAUNCH[@]}" cursor-agent -p …`, :118 and :122). It is a fixed value, never taken from the operator's environment or `FM_ADAPTER_ARGS`; an operator value of the variable is overwritten. bin/fm-sandbox.sh's scrub (`env -u …`, :327-335) unsets only the policy's named credentials and prefixes (bin/lib/fm_registry.py SCRUB :304-308), so the variable reaches the confined CLI; bin/fm-sandbox.sh is not changed. A comment beside the export says why (the keychain deny, plan B, the variable's three values, that it is undocumented). Effect on the pre-round model check, stated in the comment and in design: with `memory` the unconfined `--list-models` no longer reads the operator's own `agent login` session from the keychain, so unless a `CURSOR_API_KEY` is already in the adapter's environment it exits 1 and `fm_adapter_model_listcheck` stays silent (its documented 'could not be asked' path, bin/adapters/_lib.sh:578-610); the round's own transcript check `fm_adapter_model_refusal` (:126-130) remains the final word on an unknown model. This also ends the one place a cursor call touched the operator's keychain, which design §13.1's cursor row already forbids ('Never `agent login`'s own items').

Change 2, the probe. bin/fm-auth-probe.sh's `vendor_env` case (:168-174) gains `cursor-agent) vendor_env=(AGENT_CLI_CREDENTIAL_STORE=memory) ;;`, exported by `run_probe` after its scrub (:275) like the claude and codex entries. The argv (`cursor-agent --list-models`, :143), the Darwin `sandbox-exec` confinement and `started` marker (:150-163), the timeout and the classification order (:316-342) are unchanged.

Change 3, the keychain branch and reasons. With `memory` a nonzero exit mentioning `keychain` (:332) can only mean the installed cursor-agent ignored `AGENT_CLI_CREDENTIAL_STORE`. The branch stays (fail closed) but its reason, printed in the `keychain-blocked` case (:393-402) in the not-confinement-failure arm, becomes: en `cursor-agent tried to store its login in the keychain, which crew rounds deny; this cursor-agent version may no longer honour AGENT_CLI_CREDENTIAL_STORE=memory; run fm doctor` / tw `cursor-agent 試圖把登入存進鑰匙圈，而 crew 回合禁止存取鑰匙圈；此版本的 cursor-agent 可能已不支援 AGENT_CLI_CREDENTIAL_STORE=memory；請執行 fm doctor`. The confinement-failure reason ('could not confine cursor-agent's keychain access') is unchanged. The no-crew-key reason (:103-111, 'no crew Cursor API key is stored; cursor-agent's own sign-in (agent login) lives in the macOS keychain, which crew rounds cannot read') is unchanged: it remains true, since a round still never reads `agent login`'s keychain session. The timeout reason is unchanged.

Change 4, fm doctor, through its facts layer (design §13.3 '#### T-157: diagnosing collected facts'; bin/fm-doctor.sh:100-108 'The judging layer reads observations, never command -v or --version'). Collecting: `collect_tools` (:161-196) emits one new row only for an installed cursor-agent (its tool row's path non-empty): `bundle<TAB>cursor-agent<TAB><state>`, where state is `names` if any `*.js` file in the directory of the real path of that tool row's path names the fixed string `AGENT_CLI_CREDENTIAL_STORE` (`grep -lF`, first match is enough), `absent` if none does, `unreadable` if the real path or the directory cannot be resolved or read. The real path is resolved with `python3 -c 'import os,sys;print(os.path.realpath(sys.argv[1]))'` (macOS `readlink -f` is not assumed) and never hard-coded to ~/.local/share/cursor-agent/versions (cursor auto-updates and the symlink moves). `--collect` prints the row with the others. The format comment at :100-102 names the row. Judging: in the `== Vendor logins ==` loop (:322-), for cursor-agent only, after it is present and passes the version floor (`vendor_min` 2026.10.01, :313-319, unchanged), `fact_value bundle cursor-agent 3` is read: `names` or no bundle row at all (a facts file from before this change, or supplied without it) -> no extra line; `absent` -> `say_bad cursor-agent "installed cursor-agent <version> no longer names AGENT_CLI_CREDENTIAL_STORE; crew rounds would stall on keychain writes, so the probe refuses it; pin or reinstall a version that has it"`; `unreadable` -> `say_warn cursor-agent "could not read the installed cursor-agent bundle to check it still names AGENT_CLI_CREDENTIAL_STORE"`. The judging layer never runs `command -v`, `grep` on the host or `--version`, so `--facts` (tests/doctor.test.sh:67, bin/fm-setup.sh:231-233) stays host-independent. Where cursor-agent is not installed (CI) no bundle row exists and the existing 'missing: not installed' line is the only one, as today.

Fixtures. Add tests/fixtures/auth-status/cursor-agent-signed-in-memory.txt with the same header format as its siblings: `# recorded: yes`, `# command: cursor-agent --list-models`, `# cli: 2026.10.01-e373342`, `# date: 2026-10-05`, `# host: macOS, Darwin 24.6.0, outside any round, env -i with an empty temp HOME, under the auth-probe sandbox profile`, `# setup: the crew key as CURSOR_API_KEY, AGENT_CLI_CREDENTIAL_STORE=memory`, `# redacted: the model list after its first two entries`, `# exit: 0`, then exactly these lines: `Available models`, an empty line, `auto - Auto (default)`, `gpt-5.3-codex-low - Codex 5.3 Low`. The existing cursor-agent-signed-in.txt (default store, with the keychain-save warning), cursor-agent-signed-out.txt and cursor-agent-key-rejected.txt are kept unchanged: their outputs under `memory` were recorded identical apart from the absent warning, and the old signed-in recording still proves the model list wins over a keychain warning. Every stub answers with these recorded bytes; none is written from the code.

Tests (fail-first; workers do not run suites, CI and the gates verify). tests/auth-probe.test.sh: (a) the probe's cursor-agent stub records its environment (the existing `$d/cursor-agent-env` mechanism, :159-167) and the test asserts it contains `AGENT_CLI_CREDENTIAL_STORE=memory`, and that claude's and codex's recorded environments do not; (b) `recorded cursor-agent cursor-agent-signed-in-memory` -> `authenticated` with the existing model-list reason; (c) the existing keychain case (:199-203, `A Keychain cannot be found to store "cursor-user"; not logged in`, exit 1) now asserts the new en and tw reasons from Change 3; (d) the confinement-failure and no-key reasons are asserted unchanged. tests/adapter-protocol.test.sh: a cursor-agent stub that appends `${AGENT_CLI_CREDENTIAL_STORE-unset}` to a file on every call; one round with `FM_MODEL` set records `memory` twice (the `--list-models` preflight and the `-p` run), also when the caller's environment had `AGENT_CLI_CREDENTIAL_STORE=default`. tests/doctor.test.sh, judging through supplied facts only (its rule at :22, data never stubs): cursor-agent tool row at 2026.10.01 plus `bundle cursor-agent names` -> no new line; `absent` -> the new `say_bad` naming the version; `unreadable` -> the new `say_warn`; no bundle row -> no new line; cursor-agent missing -> only the 'missing' line (regression). One collector test runs `fm-doctor.sh --collect` with a PATH holding a `cursor-agent` symlink into a temp `versions/<v>/` directory whose `index.js` contains the string -> `bundle\tcursor-agent\tnames`; the same without the string -> `absent`; this collector test may use a fake PATH because it exercises collection, not judging (state that in a comment beside it). Each assertion of new behaviour is red on main 7c9877e: auth-probe (a), (b) and (c); the adapter-protocol `memory` assertions; doctor `absent`, `unreadable` and both collector cases. Regression guards, which pass on main by design and say so in a comment beside each: auth-probe (d), doctor `names`, doctor 'no bundle row', doctor 'cursor-agent missing'.

Callers, mirrors and fixtures checked (grep `cursor-agent` and `list-models` over bin/ and tests/): bin/adapters/cursor-agent.sh, bin/fm-auth-probe.sh and bin/fm-doctor.sh change; bin/fm-config.sh changes in one comment only: the comment above `fm_model_known` (:627-634) says cursor-agent's `--list-models` 'needs the operator's own login' and that the adapter's preflight asks the CLI 'once it is authenticated'; it is rewritten to say the list needs a `CURSOR_API_KEY` (cursor keeps no login of its own under `AGENT_CLI_CREDENTIAL_STORE=memory`), so the adapter's preflight answers only when one is already in its environment and is otherwise silent, and the offline check stays uncatalogued (2) for cursor-agent as today; no code in fm-config.sh changes; bin/adapters/_lib.sh (`fm_auth_probe`, `fm_adapter_model_listcheck`), bin/fm-worker.sh and bin/fm-review.sh (`fm_auth_filter_chain`), bin/fm-sandbox.sh and bin/lib/fm_registry.py read the variable through unchanged paths and do not change. Test stubs that answer `--list-models` without checking the environment and keep passing unchanged: tests/worker-auth.test.sh:52-66, tests/canary.test.sh:123-137, tests/adapter-protocol.test.sh:62-96 and :266-274, tests/lib/herdr.py. bin/adapters/_contract.md:186-192 mirrors the same claim ('`cursor-agent --list-models`, once it holds a real login' and 'no login yet'); it gets the same rewording as design §11: the list answers once it is given a `CURSOR_API_KEY`, and run before the round's key is handed in it is normally silent.

Design (edit in place, no new section at the end of design.md, T-189): §13.3 'Setup, doctor and the vendor probe' — in the paragraph that begins 'For cursor-agent's own answer (T-195)' replace the keychain reason with the Change 3 text and replace 'The separate adapter model-list check still uses the operator's real HOME.' with one sentence that cursor rounds, the probe and the adapter's model-list check run with `AGENT_CLI_CREDENTIAL_STORE=memory`, so cursor never stores or reads a login in the keychain, the adapter check is silent without a `CURSOR_API_KEY`, and fm doctor checks the installed bundle still names the variable. §13.1's cursor-agent row of the login table (the row beginning '| cursor-agent | the crew's Cursor API key') gains in its 'how it is handed in' cell: 'with `AGENT_CLI_CREDENTIAL_STORE=memory`, so cursor keeps the login in memory and never in the keychain (plan B, 2026-10-05)'. §13.3's '#### T-157: diagnosing collected facts' subsection gains, in the sentence listing the row kinds, that bundle rows carry `cursor-agent` and `names`, `absent` or `unreadable`, emitted only for an installed cursor-agent. §11's paragraph on the pre-round model check (design/design.md about :2964, under '## 11. Self-update') (the one beginning '`cursor-agent` is the one vendor of the four whose CLI can list its own models offline', T-127) replaces 'once it holds a real login' with 'once it is given a `CURSOR_API_KEY`' and adds that, run with `AGENT_CLI_CREDENTIAL_STORE=memory` before the round's key is handed in, the check is normally silent and the round's own answer decides. §13.3's '**Evidence.**' paragraph (the one listing the `tests/fixtures/auth-status` recordings) adds the fourth cursor recording: the working key with `AGENT_CLI_CREDENTIAL_STORE=memory` returned `Available models`, exit 0, with no keychain-save warning. Nothing else in design.md changes.

In flight and eligibility. No cursor round is in flight or possible today (every cursor probe currently ends in timeout, so `fm_auth_refuses`, bin/adapters/_lib.sh:311, removes cursor from every chain). After this lands, the cursor probe reads `authenticated` with a working crew key, so cursor-agent becomes eligible wherever a project's config already lists it as a fallback, behind the configured primary vendors; no config.yaml changes, and the captain's rule (codex/claude first, cursor only on quota exhaustion) is unchanged. Firstmate needs no restart: the probe and adapter are read fresh per dispatch from the code snapshot. If a cursor update drops the variable, cursor goes back to timing out and being refused (fail closed), and fm doctor names the cause.

Out of scope: the keychain deny itself, the auth-probe profile, bin/fm-sandbox.sh, other vendors, the cursor round's own sandbox flags, and deleting the operator's stuck `cursor-access-token`/`cursor-user` keychain item (it is the operator's own login and irrelevant with `memory`).
